thread.title: Tech stocks drop in late trading after Apple trims forecast

author: Jeremy C. Owens
title: Tech stocks drop in late trading after Apple trims forecast
text:
Some of the biggest names in technology saw shares decline in after-hours trading Wednesday, after Apple Inc. AAPL, -9.99% trimmed its forecast for holiday sales . Apple suppliers were some of the hardest hit, with Skyworks Solutions Inc. SWKS, -8.83% Qorvo Inc. QRVO, -9.45% and Broadcom Inc. AVGO, -5.98% all down at least 5% as of 6 p.m. Eastern time. Other members of the so-called "FAANG" grouping of tech stocks were also hit: Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -2.02% dropped about 3%, Facebook Inc. FB, -2.17% was down 1.6%, Alphabet Inc. GOOG, -2.14% GOOGL, -2.03% declined almost 2%, and Netflix Inc. NFLX, -0.59% declined about 3%. Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -3.41% which took the title as most valuable public company in the U.S. from Apple late last year, was down more than 2%. Chip makers Nvidia Corp. NVDA, -6.00% Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD, -8.61% and Micron Technology Inc. MU, -5.34% all saw shares decline 3% or more as well.
See Full Story Apple cuts holiday sales forecast on iPhone and China weakness, stock falls 8% Apple Inc. lowered its holiday-quarter revenue forecast Wednesday afternoon, largely due to slowing iPhone sales and pressure in China.
